key_insight: Scalarization connects interval-valued optimization to scalar problems, enabling a proximal point algorithm with global convergence guarantees.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a principled approach to interval-valued lasso regression when data uncertainty is represented by intervals.
method: Scalarize the unconstrained interval-valued objective and relate scalar optima to LU-nondominated solutions.
Apply a proximal point algorithm to the scalarized formulation.
Establish sublinear convergence for convex cases and linear convergence for strongly convex cases.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports numerical experiments, comparison with an existing method, and an interval-valued lasso application, but gives no quantitative results.
watch_item: Practical scalability and the cost of solving proximal subproblems are not specified in the abstract.
paper_title: Proximal point algorithm for interval valued optimization problems with application to lasso problem
